confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded estimates from secondary aggregated sources: a June 2026 Numbeo-derived snapshot (via Expatica), Córdoba guide price ranges, and one dated cost-of-living page. Beer, coffee, cocktail and wine are less certain than the meal anchors. Cocktail and wine are based on guide ranges rather than the beer ratio, and the cappuccino figure is a judgement, since no current euro price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context. No live booking pages or current listings were inspected. EUR values were converted to USD at an assumed 1 EUR = 1.16 USD, which was not retrieved from a source. The FX observation is the latest official RBA value I could retrieve, dated 2026-03-20, and it is not the latest published rate. I could not retrieve a current RBA observation, so the fx field is stale and the server should weigh that when converting.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Andalusian tourist city, priced below Granada and Seville for restaurants and drinks, using aggregated Córdoba price ranges. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Spanish city in July high season, with no accommodation search performed.
